commit.message:
feat(dm): emoji reactions on messages (#4633)

Privacy follows NIP-17 spec line 14: kind-7 NIP-25 reactions ride the
same seal + gift-wrap envelope as kind-14/15 DMs. Reuse of the existing
NIP17MessageService pipeline keeps every privacy guarantee of the
underlying DM (no metadata leak, no public group identifier).

User-facing surface:

- Long-press on a DM bubble opens a combined picker overlay with a
  quick row of six emojis (❤️ 😂 🔥 😮 😢 👍) plus a "+" entry for
  the full picker, layered above the existing Copy / Delete / Report
  actions in a single gesture.
- Reactions render as compact bordered chips beneath each bubble,
  overlapping the bubble's bottom corner.
- Cap-at-one per user per message in v1; toggling a different emoji
  publishes a NIP-09 kind-5 deletion of the prior reaction.
- Hidden on failed-send own DMs (reacting to a message the recipient
  never received would be meaningless).

Reliability hardening for the publish path:

- Hard 15 s timeout on every sendRumor call so a stalled relay socket
  can't lock the user out of further retries.
- New DmReactionsDao.markPending writes the in-flight state to the
  DAO row before the send, so the chip's truth source survives a cubit
  rebuild / navigation away & back / hot-restart.
- BlocBuilder with per-message buildWhen replaces a BlocSelector that
  only watched the reactions list and missed pending-map transitions.
- Taps on pending chips are dropped at the row level so a tap during
  retry-in-flight can't fall through to the toggle branch and silently
  delete the in-flight reaction.

Architecture (UI → BLoC → Repository → Client per the project rule):

- `DmMessageReactions` Drift table with dedup on (id, owner_pubkey),
  partial indexes on the hot read paths, soft-delete tombstones.
- `DmReactionsRepository` extends `dm_repository` with publish,
  retry, removeOwn, watchForConversation, persistIncoming. Reuses
  `DmRepository.computeConversationId` for the 1:1 conversation
  resolution on incoming reactions.
- `DmRepository._handleGiftWrapEvent` routes `rumor.kind == 7` to
  the reactions repository ahead of the existing 14/15 gate.
- `ConversationReactionsCubit` per conversation, restartable on
  Started, sequential on Toggled/Retry. addError without Reportable
  wrap per the error-handling matrix (publish failures are network/IO
  class). `BlocProvider` keyed on the Riverpod-derived repository
  identity per state_management.md.
- `ReactionChip` lands in `divine_ui` (strict-coverage tests included)
  with a 28 dp circular pill for single emoji and a capsule when a
  count or retry icon joins. Strut + leading distribution + height
  behaviour pin Apple's emoji glyph on the chip's geometric centre.
- `ReactionsRow` + `ReactionPickerOverlay` live in the feature folder.

l10n: 11 new dmReaction* keys added to app_en.arb with @key metadata;
keys added to _knownUntranslatedDebt per the user-memory rule
(matches the #4631 markdown PR precedent). Translation pass deferred
as a follow-up.

Out of scope for v1 (tracked separately): emoji_picker_flutter wiring
for the "+" entry, group-DM reaction routing, reaction notifications,
multi-react per message, full ARB translation, reaction detail sheet.

Brainstorm doc at `mobile/docs/brainstorm/2026-05-23-issue4633-dm-emoji-reactions-brainstorm.md`
captures the 60-round design exploration (excluded from this commit
per the no-commit-brainstorm rule).

commit.message:
fix(security): strip BYOK nsec from Keycast OAuth and gate secure-account upgrade (#4665)

* fix(security): strip BYOK nsec from Keycast OAuth and gate secure-account upgrade (#3359)

The secure-account upgrade exported the user's local nsec and sent it to Keycast in the registration request body and embedded in the PKCE code_verifier (plus a derived byok_pubkey query param), leaking the private key over the wire and into the OAuth challenge.

Remove the nsec/BYOK surface from the keycast_flutter OAuth client entirely so no caller can re-introduce it, purge any persisted nsec-bearing verifier on load before it can be replayed, and stop logging the verifier value. A POSIX-grep CI guard fails the build if body['nsec'] / 'nsec': reappears in production code.

Rather than fall through to the server's auto-generate path -- which silently re-creates the user's identity under a new pubkey and wipes local social-graph caches via shouldClearDataForUser -- the upgrade is paused behind a notice and its entry points (Settings tile, profile-actions prompt) are hidden. #3786 restores the upgrade via the proof-of-possession contract (keycast#197) once it ships.

Negative-regression tests across pkce, oauth_client, secure_account_screen, and pending_verification assert the nsec never appears. The session-expired-banner integration test is skipped pending #3786 (it relies on the BYOK local-key fallback this change removes).

* fix(ui): title secure-account screen with VineTheme.headlineLargeFont

The rewritten paused-upgrade screen titled with a raw TextStyle while
its body already used VineTheme.bodyLargeFont. Swap to the matching
design-system helper (Bricolage 32/w700/whiteText) per review feedback;
this also restores the line-height and letter-spacing the raw style
dropped, and matches the sibling auth-screen titles.

commit.message:
feat(observability): enrich Bloc error reports with last event, state, and build tag (#3758) (#4666)

* feat(observability): enrich Bloc error reports with last event, state, and build tag

DivineBlocObserver tracks each bloc's latest event (onEvent) and state (onChange) with no IO until onError, then attaches them plus the last transition time as sanitized Crashlytics custom keys (bloc.lastEvent / bloc.lastState / bloc.lastTransitionAt) before recordError. main.dart sets a build_tag key once at startup. Closes the per-error triage gap that made the #3503 auth-timing investigation expensive.

Keys are dispatched synchronously and in order so the platform-channel messages stay ordered without blocking the bloc error path.

Closes #3758

* fix(observability): clear stale bloc diagnostics

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
fix(tags-picker): keep search results visible after selecting a suggestion (#4663)

* fix(tags-picker): keep search results visible after selecting a suggestion (#4641)

Previously, tapping a suggestion in the video metadata tags picker dispatched TagsPickerSearchReset, which wiped the query and suggestion list. This made it tedious to pick multiple related tags in a row.

Now _addTag dispatches TagsPickerTagsAdded only, and the text field is cleared by temporarily detaching the controller listener so no TagsPickerQueryChanged('') is fired. The bloc keeps its query + suggestions, letting users rapidly select several tags.

Also:

- Wrap the _TagChip label in Flexible with maxLines:1 + ellipsis so long tags don't overflow the chip.

- Drop now-dead TagsPickerSearchReset event, registration, and handler.

- Update widget test to assert that the previous query ('mus') stays visible after a suggestion tap.

* test(tags-picker): document the double pump after suggestion tap

* fix(tags-picker): restore stable preserved-search state

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>
